question: What will be the highest intraday value of the VVIX for the two-week period through November 27, 2026?

calls.reasoning: Reference class: the highest intraday VVIX over a two-week window that starts roughly 7-16 trading days after a sharp VIX shock. Examples are Feb 2018, Aug 2024, Dec 2024 and Apr 2025. After those shocks the window high usually landed between about 100 and 125, because VVIX falls back but stays elevated while VIX is above about 18. Today (Nov 5, 2026) VIX rose about 64% to close near 27.65 in an AI and chip selloff, and VVIX hit an intraday high of 132 (Investing.com). VVIX has been spiking repeatedly since mid-October: intraday highs of 121, 118 and 124 came within three weeks before today. The window includes the reaction to Nvidia's earnings (reported Nov 17 after the close, so trading reacts Nov 18) and the VIX monthly expiration. Thanksgiving week is thin trading, which argues for lower values in the second half. Below 90 would need full calm. Early October's quiet regime showed highs of only 82-92.

calls.reconciliation: The three runs were nearly identical in distribution. Factual disputes were minor. Nov 5 VVIX close: 128.71 (Investing, possibly a live quote) vs ~130.4 (Yahoo); both agree on the 132.11 high, which is immaterial to the window. VIX close: 27.02 vs 27.65; same shock magnitude either way. Nvidia earnings: Nov 17 AMC (one run citing MarketBeat) vs ~Nov 19-20 unconfirmed; inside the window in every case. None of these could be verified without web access, but none changes the bins. Judgment: how much mass goes to >=110 vs <100. Given repeated 118-124 intraday spikes in late Oct even at low VIX, plus the ongoing deleveraging and Nvidia catalyst, I put slightly more mass on >=120 and slightly less on 90-100 than runs 1 and 3. I carried the runs' post-shock reference class forward because I agree with it.
